headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 1% in the half-day session, while the AI comic-drama concept surged again. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.2% in the half-day session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.6%, Xiaomi Group rose more than 5%, and Meituan rose more than 4%. China's September CPI rose 0.9% year-on-year, with the increase widening; PPI rose 5.0% year-on-year, the largest increase since June 2022. In US dollar terms, China's September exports rose 36.3% year-on-year and imports rose 31.0% year-on-year, both above expectations. European Central Bank Governing Council member and Belgian central bank governor Wunsch expects the ECB may have to raise rates again.

headlines.title: 美国9月CPI将决定2027年社保金调整幅度，或创三年来最大涨幅
headlines.summary: 今晚将公布的美国9月CPI报告将决定2027年美国社会保障福利的生活成本调整（COLA）幅度。根据美国社会保障局的计算规则，年度COLA取决于第三季度（7月至9月）城市工薪阶层和文职人员消费者价格指数（CPI-W）平均值相较上年同期的涨幅。劳工统计局数据显示，7月CPI-W指数为327.104，同比上涨3.4%；8月指数升至328.481，同比上涨3.5%。今晚公布的9月CPI-W数据将补齐第三季度最后一个月的数据，并据此确定2027年社保福利的最终上调幅度。最新预测显示，2027年COLA可能达到3.5%，高于2026年的2.8%，有望创三年来最大涨幅

headlines.title_en: US September CPI will determine the 2027 Social Security COLA, possibly the largest increase in three years
headlines.summary_en: The US September CPI report to be released tonight will determine the size of the cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for US Social Security benefits in 2027. According to the calculation rules of the US Social Security Administration, the annual COLA depends on the year-on-year increase in the average Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers (CPI-W) for the third quarter (July to September). Bureau of Labor Statistics data show that the July CPI-W index was 327.104, up 3.4% year-on-year; the August index rose to 328.481, up 3.5% year-on-year. The September CPI-W data released tonight will complete the final month of the third quarter and determine the final increase in Social Security benefits for 2027. The latest forecasts show that the 2027 COLA may reach 3.5%, higher than 2.8% in 2026, and may be the largest increase in three years.

headlines.title: 9月份我国货物贸易进出口首破5万亿元 增长27.5%
headlines.summary: 据海关统计，今年前三季度，我国货物贸易进出口39.94万亿元，同比增长18.8%。其中，出口23.2万亿元，增长16.4%，进口16.74万亿元，增长22.3%。月度增速连续6个月保持两位数增长，9月份进出口5.16万亿元，首次突破了5万亿元，增长27.5%。其中，出口3.03万亿元，增长29.6%；进口2.13万亿元，增长24.6%。

headlines.title_en: In September, China's goods trade imports and exports exceeded 5 trillion yuan for the first time, up 27.5%
headlines.summary_en: According to customs statistics, in the first three quarters of this year, China's goods trade imports and exports totaled 39.94 trillion yuan, up 18.8% year-on-year. Among this, exports were 23.2 trillion yuan, up 16.4%, and imports were 16.74 trillion yuan, up 22.3%. Monthly growth remained in double digits for six consecutive months. In September, imports and exports totaled 5.16 trillion yuan, exceeding 5 trillion yuan for the first time, up 27.5%. Among this, exports were 3.03 trillion yuan, up 29.6%; imports were 2.13 trillion yuan, up 24.6%.

headlines.title_en: Institutions: US September inflation is expected to continue accelerating; gasoline pushes up CPI, diesel intensifies producer-side inflation
headlines.summary_en: Bill Adams, Chief US Economist at Fifth Third Bank, expects that US September CPI will again show a relatively high increase, driven by a rebound in gasoline prices. Rising fuel costs may also push up airfare prices, which are part of core CPI. Other components of core CPI are expected to rise relatively modestly. New and used vehicle prices may decline slightly as dealers clear inventory through discounts and promotions. Prices for most other durable goods are expected to change little. Housing inflation may slow again, reflecting the lagged pass-through effects of moderate increases in home prices and rents last year and earlier this year. PPI inflation may be higher than CPI because September diesel prices rose more than gasoline, and diesel prices have a greater impact on producer costs. headlines.title_en: October 14 midday review: ChiNext Index fell more than 1% in the half-day session; AI comic drama concept surged again
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated sideways in the morning, while the ChiNext Index fell more than 1%. The AI comic-drama concept surged again, with Guomai Culture, New Classic, Yinli Media, Ciwen Media and many other stocks hitting the daily limit. The PCB concept continued its upward trend, with Mankun Technology, Jinlu Electronics, Aohong Electronics, Baoding Technology and others hitting the daily limit. Oil and gas stocks rallied, with Bomeike hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the wind power sector fell, with Weili Transmission and Dajin Heavy Industry down more than 8%. More stocks fell than rose, with more than 3,600 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and half-day turnover of 860.8 billion yuan. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.01%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.51%, and the ChiNext Index fell 1.15%. 2. headlines.title: 海关总署：前三季度我国进口存储部件增长1.5倍
headlines.summary: 海关总署副署长王军在国新办新闻发布会上表示，前三季度进口快速增长，主要得益于我国经济运行平稳、超大规模市场效应持续释放、先进制造业不断发展壮大、关键零部件等各类中间品需求旺盛。前三季度，我国进口存储部件增长1.5倍，集成电路增长56.6%，航空器零部件增长17.6%。

headlines.title_en: General Administration of Customs: In the first three quarters, China's imports of storage components increased 1.5-fold
headlines.summary_en: Vice Minister of the General Administration of Customs Wang Jun said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the rapid growth in imports in the first three quarters was mainly due to the stable operation of China's economy, the continued release of the effects of its super-large market, the continuous development and expansion of advanced manufacturing, and strong demand for key components and various intermediate goods. In the first three quarters, China's imports of storage components increased 1.5 times, integrated circuits increased 56.6%, and aircraft parts increased 17.6%.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: The total fertilizer import tariff quota for 2027 is 13.65 million tons
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced the total 2027 fertilizer import tariff quota, allocation principles and related procedures. The total 2027 fertilizer import tariff quota is 13.65 million tons. Of this, urea is 3.3 million tons; diammonium phosphate is 6.9 million tons; compound fertilizer is 3.45 million tons.

headlines.title_en: China's September exports in US dollar terms rose 36.3% year-on-year, estimated at +25.7%
headlines.summary_en: China's September exports rose 36.3% year on year in US dollar terms, estimated at +25.7%. China's September imports rose 31.0% year on year in US dollar terms, estimated at +25.0%. China's September trade surplus was US$133.53 billion, estimated at a surplus of US$117.78 billion. In the first three quarters, China's exports rose 21.3% year on year in US dollar terms, while imports rose 27.5% year on year.
